items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I asked about you one time. It was Bob Scobie, I think, when New Yorker, Turk 1. Saw you around here taking a whole lot of pictures.

ctx.x: All right. Let's stop for two minutes. I know that. Did you know that that was a great photographer?

Well, I heard about it. What? Yeah, somebody said that you were taking a lot of pictures in New York. I asked about you one time. It was Bob Scobie, I think, when New Yorker, Turk 1. Saw you around here taking a whole lot of pictures. Oh, that and there's your head again. He's a first-rate photographer.
There's no one who's known as Weegee around town.
